tool_schemas.name: chat_completion
tool_schemas.description: Creates a chat completion against the requested OpenRouter model (or alias) using the provided messages and generation settings, and returns the upstream completion response while recording request/response metadata, lifecycle status, and usage for audit, debugging, and cost tracking (streaming is supported when stream=true). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, message objects are malformed (role/content), api_key_id/upstream_api_key_id do not match the required format, or unsupported parameter types are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to use the referenced API key records or model, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client or upstream key has exceeded enforced limits. Raises NOT_FOUND when the selected model (after alias resolution) or referenced key record does not exist in the catalog, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when OpenRouter rejects the request (e.g., model disabled/deprecated upstream, context limits exceeded, or other upstream validation failures).

api_key_id.description: ID of the client API key record used for this request.

upstream_api_key_id.description: ID of the upstream OpenRouter API key record to route the request through.

model.description: Requested model identifier (OpenRouter model id like 'openai/gpt-4o' or an alias).

messages.description: Chat messages to send to the model (OpenAI-style message objects).

content.description: Message content (string or structured content parts).

name.description: Optional name for the message author.

tool_call_id.description: Tool call id this tool-role message responds to (if applicable).

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion.

stop.description: Stop sequence(s) that will truncate generation.

stream.description: Whether to stream tokens as they are generated.

seed.description: Optional random seed for deterministic sampling (if supported upstream).

response_format.description: Optional response format configuration (e.g., JSON mode) forwarded to upstream.

metadata.description: Optional metadata to associate with the recorded chat completion.

tool_schemas.name: search_models
tool_schemas.description: Lists models from the locally mirrored OpenRouter catalog that match the provided filters and returns a single page of results ordered by the requested sort/order, using limit to cap page size and cursor as an opaque token to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when limit is < 1, status/sort/order are not one of the allowed values, or filter types are invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not allowed to access the model catalog.

provider.description: Filter to models from a specific provider.

min_context_length.description: Filter to models with context_length greater than or equal to this value.

max_context_length.description: Filter to models with context_length less than or equal to this value.

tags.description: Filter to models containing all specified tags.

limit.description: Maximum number of models to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_model_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full stored details for a single model in the local OpenRouter mirror, including identifiers and catalog metadata for that model. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when model_id is missing or not a string. Raises NOT_FOUND when no model (or alias target) exists for the provided model_id, and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not allowed to access the model catalog.

model_id.description: Model identifier to fetch (OpenRouter model id like 'openai/gpt-4o' or an alias).

tool_schemas.name: validate_model
tool_schemas.description: Validates that a model identifier (including aliases) resolves to a known model in the local OpenRouter mirror and returns a validation result indicating whether it is usable. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when model_id is missing or not a string. Raises NOT_FOUND when the identifier does not resolve to any known model, and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not allowed to access the model catalog.

model_id.description: Model identifier to validate (OpenRouter model id like 'openai/gpt-4o' or an alias).

tool_schemas.name: get_model_alias
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single model alias record by id and returns the stored alias, target model_id, and status. Raises NOT_FOUND when the alias id does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to view aliases.

id.description: Primary key of the model_aliases record.

tool_schemas.name: upsert_model_alias
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates a model alias. When id is provided, updates the existing alias; otherwise creates a new alias. Enforces global uniqueness of alias and refuses alias values that match any existing models.model_id. Returns the persisted model_aliases record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR on invalid fields or uniqueness violations, NOT_FOUND when updating a missing id, and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks permission.

id.description: Primary key of the model_aliases record to update; omit to create.

model_id.description: Primary key of the models record this alias points to.

alias.description: Globally unique alias string that resolves to the target model.

alias_type.description: Classification of alias intent; used for discovery and auditing.

tool_schemas.name: set_model_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a model's lifecycle status (active, deprecated, disabled) in the local catalog mirror. Refuses illegal transitions (e.g., disabled->deprecated) with VALIDATION_ERROR. Returns the updated models record. Raises NOT_FOUND if the model id does not exist and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks permission.

id.description: Primary key of the models record to transition.

status.description: Target lifecycle status for the model.

tool_schemas.name: get_chat_completion
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single recorded chat completion request/response by id, including status, resolved model, usage, cost, and any error fields. Returns the stored chat_completions record. Raises NOT_FOUND when the id does not exist and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to view the record.

id.description: Primary key of the chat_completions record.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_chat_completion
tool_schemas.description: Attempts to cancel an in-flight chat completion. Cancellation is only allowed while status is queued or running; if already succeeded/failed/cancelled the request is refused. Returns the updated chat_completions record. Raises NOT_FOUND when the id does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR when the completion is not cancellable, and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks permission.

id.description: Primary key of the chat_completions record to cancel.

reason.description: Optional cancellation reason to persist for audit/debugging.

metadata.name: OpenRouter MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend powers an MCP server façade over OpenRouter: it maintains a local catalog of models mirrored from OpenRouter, and records chat completion requests/responses for audit, debugging, and cost tracking. Primary workflows are (1) listing/filtering models and fetching model details/validation
